pokedexEntries.di: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

pokedexEntries.prl: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

pokedexEntries.pt: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

pokedexEntries.la: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

pokedexEntries.vi: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will mercilessly decimate anything that threatens the safety of its colony.
